title: SAM2-UNet: segment anything 2 makes strong encoder for natural and medical image segmentation
mechanism: SAM 2 Hiera encoder kept mostly frozen with small adapters, feeding a plain U-Net decoder; Hiera has a stride-4 first stage so fine detail survives into the skips.
adaptation: 1-channel EL replicated to 3 channels; Hiera-L (and B+); one arm at 512 and one at 1024 (2x bilinear upscale); replace binary head with 24-class head, house CE + soft Dice on crack/inactive, label-safe aug only, val-chosen crack logit bias; also ensemble with the house U-Net++ (heterogeneous ensembles untested here).
evidence: R: beats specialised SOTA on camouflage, salient, mirror, marine, polyp segmentation (abstract only); 242 citations. No thin-structure numbers in abstract.
min_experiment: Arms SAM2-UNet Hiera-L @512 and @1024, 3 seeds, 20k steps vs house U-Net++ and PF. Metrics clean-49 crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob; E1 crack relF1@2 and inactive IoU; 5-fold CV. Also SAM2-UNet+house ensemble vs house 5-seed ensemble. Kill if crack IoU < 0.465 and relF1@2 < 0.875 and E1 relF1@2 < 0.43 and ensemble adds < +0.01 crack IoU.
prior_overlap: Foundation encoders row: only a frozen linear probe of SAM2 Hiera-T was run. Adapter fine-tuning of Hiera-L with a U-Net decoder and 1024 input is listed as not closed.

alt_notes.adaptation: Gray to 3 channels, 512 px, Hiera-B+ or L. Hiera stage 1 is stride 4, so add a full-resolution conv skip from the raw image or 1-2 px cracks vanish. 24-class head, house CE plus Dice on crack and inactive.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SAM2-UNet Hiera-B+ with adapters and extra full-res skip; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, E1 crack relF1@2, mIoU_rob. Kill if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.01 and E1 n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Gray replicated to 3 channels, 512 px, Hiera-B+ or L. Hiera stage 1 is stride 4, so add a full or half resolution conv skip from the raw image, or 1 to 2 px cracks are lost. 24-class head, house CE + Dice. SECrackSeg (doi:10.3390/s25092642) shows the same design used for cracks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SAM2-UNet with full-res skip, 24 classes; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, E1 crack relF1@2, mIoU_rob. Kill if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.01 and E1 n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: 1-ch EL replicated to 3 ch, 512 upscaled to 1024; Hiera-B+ or L; 24-class head; add stride-2 conv stem skip so 1-2 px cracks reach the decoder; house CE + Dice on crack/inactive, label-safe aug, 20k steps, encoder lr 0.1x (PF-style).
alt_notes.min_experiment: SAM2-UNet Hiera-B+ at 1024 vs house PF; module-grouped 5-fold CV (1 seed/fold) then 3 seeds on clean-49 and E1. Kill if CV crack relF1@2 > 0.005 below PF AND E1 crack relF1@2 not >= PF+0.03 AND E1 inactive IoU not > 0.24.

alt_notes.adaptation: Hierarchical stride-4 encoder avoids the stride-16 crack dilution (70.7% of crack signal below 1/4 at stride 16 vs 8.5% at stride 4, idea08 file). Hiera-B+ or L at 1024, add a stride-2 stem skip, 24-class head, house loss, 20k steps. Overlaps D14 item 1.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SAM2-UNet Hiera-B+ at 1024. Baseline: house PF. Metric: CV crack relF1@2 and inactive IoU, then 3 seeds clean-49 and E1. Kill: default line.

alt_notes.adaptation: Hiera-B+ / L at 512 and 1024 px, add a stride-2 image skip, 24-class head, house loss. Hiera is stride 4, so no ViT stride problem.
alt_notes.min_experiment: SAM2-UNet Hiera-B+ vs house PF, CV then 3 seeds; default kill line.
